notes: Investigated independently (not assumed to mirror West Elm US SR2's /shop/holidays/ taxonomy). Site is a NetSuite SuiteCommerce Advanced storefront (client-rendered) using Searchspring for on-page category/search results; exact qty taken from Searchspring category API pagination.totalResults, cross-checked against the rendered 'N products' text on the page. Checked robots.txt (no Claude-specific disallow). Enumerated the full category sitemap (SitemapFiles/WEUK/sitemap-...-category-0.xml, 511 URLs) and found only one seasonal branch: /christmas (and its Sale/click&collect variants). No Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine's, Thanksgiving, or New Year branch exists anywhere in the category sitemap, CMS sitemap, or custom-URL sitemap. Ran a search discrimination check (site's Searchspring search, param keywords=): halloween=7 (stray product matches, no dedicated category), diwali=0, valentine=0, easter=0, thanksgiving=0 -- confirms the search engine is discriminating (not a flat default count), so these zero/near-zero results are genuine absence, not a search-trap. Also checked /gift-ideas (occasion-based gifting hub: engagement, housewarming, price tiers) -- no holiday-specific gift subcategory. Excluded from rows: /christmas/all-christmas (129 products; a 'Shop All Christmas' aggregator duplicating the same product universe already captured across the Christmas Hosting + Christmas Decorating branches -- treated as a NEVER-EXTRACT 'Shop All' page per the shared core, overlap noted here rather than double-counted); /christmas/christmas-featured-shops (0 products; a pure editorial/marketing 'Featured Shops' hub with no product grid); /christmas/christmas-sale/christmas-sale, /christmas/sale-christmas, /christmas/sale-christmas/all-sale-christmas, /christmas/click-collect-christmas, /sale-sale/limited-time-offers/christmas-sale, /sale-sale/shop-all-clearance/clearance-christmas (Sale/clearance/fulfillment-method pages, not genuine categories). 'Christmas' (top) and 'Christmas Hosting' and 'Christmas Decorating' are kept as grouping rows (qty:null, link:null) because their own Searchspring totals are hierarchy rollups of their children (e.g. Christmas Decorating's own total of 113 vs its 6 children summing to ~127) rather than distinct product sets -- per Rule 9, a genuine parent whose children are subsets stays a grouping row rather than double-counting. Room/product-type overlap (e.g. Christmas Bed Linen, Christmas Cushions & Throws, Fireplace & Hearth) kept per Seasonal rules SS7-8: these are genuinely filed inside the site's own Christmas category tree, so they coexist with Textile/Home Decor categories rather than being excluded.
